_comment: Hand-maintained overrides for the open-weights heuristic in scripts/aa.py.
The free Artificial Analysis tier exposes no open_weights flag, no context window
and no parameter counts, so aa.py classifies models with a curated family list
and this table. Order of precedence: exclude > include > family list.
params values are billions of parameters: total_b = all weights, active_b = per-token
active weights for MoE models. Update by hand when you verify a checkpoint on
Hugging Face; nothing here comes from the API.
_attribution: Model metadata: artificialanalysis.ai (recorded 2026-10-19). Parameter counts verified against publisher/Hugging Face model cards.
